pins.notes: Rev. B Table 4, p. 7. The regulated VOUT rail is external, after the inductor; there is no VOUT package pin.

simulation.scope: Buck circuit with external inductor/capacitor, VOUT 2.5 V, hysteresis mode, fixed 90% estimated conversion efficiency plus IQ. Intended VIN 3.6 V. Conservative 3.0 V cutoff is an estimate; maximum 6.5 V is not enforced. PWM, STOP and transients are omitted.
